profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Google
profile.summary:
My life reached a turning point when I took my first computer science course at San Jose State University. I found programming to be a mental game that I quickly discovered I was natural at. I have the solution to any problem; all I need to do is encode it. I can always feel it emerging and coming to light, which is why I always feel motivated to spend my time working. Most of the time, I quickly derive a solution. However, the game does not end for me there. I endeavor to find an even more effective and cleaner solution, a way of leveling up in my game. This process remains very fun to me and ensures me that my home is in computer science and software engineering.

Finding new technologies and gaining more knowledge adds new elements and more life to my game. Therefore, I endeavor to learn and gain as much experience as possible. Fortunately, my skills in programming in Java and x86 Assembly behind C, collaboration, leadership, and communication has enabled me to learn and adapt quickly.

I graduated in December 2021, taking a total of only two and a half years to finish my B.S. in Computer Science. I am excited to contribute to Google!

positions.title: Independent Academic Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutor students at middle, high school, and college level in over 8 STEM subjects, including writing, Java, x86 Assembly Programming, mathematics, physics, chemistry, etc., through online platforms and physical appointments
- Help tutees obtain a strong foundation in subjects and overcome personal struggles
- Guide undergraduate student through full x86 Assembly project over the course of 15 hours, teaching concepts and programming language necessary to successfully code and understand

positions.title: Vice President of Newman Catholic Student Association, San Jose State University
positions.description:
-Manage and design the association’s website
-Maintain a database of over 30 members and their contact information
-Represent the association in worldwide intercollegiate meetings with over 25 different universities and colleges
-Transition events and activities into online platforms such as Zoom during the virtual semester
-Plan and coordinate intercollegiate events and contact speakers for talks
-Strategically recruit new members through effective communication and 6 online platforms, increasing the association membership by 150%
-Host leadership officer meetings and weekly association events

projects.title: Percolation System Model
projects.description:
-Models fluid flow through porous materials and metal conductivity
-Implement a model of a percolation system with a grid of n-by-n sites
-Opens and automatically connects sites using input from txt file
-Checks if a site is open, full, and whether the system percolates
-Determines if system percolates
-Runs input number of trials with input grid size to find mean of percolation threshold

projects.title: Custom String Bit Encryption and Decryption
projects.description:
-Implement an multi-function encrypter/decrypter tool
-Encrypts and decrypts all alpha characters without changing other characters
-Allow users to choose key for bit encryption, direction of bit rotation, and encryption or decryption
                -Skills Required: x86 Assembly, Analytical, Terminal Shell, Debugging using GDB
